spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(${metric_namespace}_liteserver_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", error_code!="0"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (rate(${metric_namespace}_liteserver_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000001)

spec.title: Cell DB generation id
spec.description: Numeric cell DB generation id for stable labels: active and pending.

spec.title: Background worker
spec.description: Current exclusive background task: idle, serializing state, migrating cell DB, pruning persistent states, or pruning archives.

spec.expr: sum by (instance, pipeline, chain, origin) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_block_origins_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success", pipeline!="blocksync"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (instance, pipeline, chain, source, result) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result!="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, pipeline, chain, source) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_block_download_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Master+shards obtain p95
spec.description: Critical-path obtain time per master transition. The shards stage records the union of shard download intervals so parallel requests are not summed.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, pipeline) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_master_shards_obtain_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success", stage="master"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, pipeline) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_master_shards_obtain_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success", stage="shards"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, pipeline) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_master_shards_obtain_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success", stage="master"}[$__rate_interval]))) + on (instance, pipeline) histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, pipeline) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_master_shards_obtain_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success", stage="shards"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, pipeline, chain) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_block_apply_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success", pipeline!="blocksync"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, mode, stage) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_checkpoint_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (instance, method, error_code, reason) (rate(${metric_namespace}_liteserver_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", error_code!="0"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (instance, generation) (rate(${metric_namespace}_storage_cell_db_cache_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance, generation) (rate(${metric_namespace}_storage_cell_db_cache_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000001)

spec.title: Cell DB read amplification
spec.description: Read amplification by cell DB generation and shard.

spec.expr: max by (instance, generation, shard) (${metric_namespace}_storage_cell_db_read_amp{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shard!="total"})

spec.title: Accepted broadcast rate
spec.description: Accepted inbound P2P broadcasts by overlay, TL type, and delivery mode. QUIC Plumtree traffic uses delivery=plumtree.

spec.expr: sum by (instance, overlay, kind, delivery) (rate(${metric_namespace}_p2p_broadcasts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", direction="accepted"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Received broadcast rate
spec.description: Inbound P2P broadcasts successfully reconstructed and parsed by the transport, before application acceptance, deduplication, or already-applied filtering.

spec.expr: sum by (instance, overlay, kind, delivery) (rate(${metric_namespace}_p2p_broadcasts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Plumtree FEC part receive rate
spec.description: Verified Plumtree FEC parts accepted into the decoder via eager direct push or repair recovery.

spec.title: Plumtree inbound message rate
spec.description: Parsed inbound Plumtree messages by protocol type, including payload, control, statistics, and repair-query traffic.

spec.title: Queue rebroadcast / overlay relay rate
spec.description: App-level rebroadcast queue sends by TL type and overlay-level relay sends by delivery path. FEC relay sends are FEC parts, not decoded TL broadcast kinds.

spec.expr: sum by (instance, overlay, kind, delivery) (rate(${metric_namespace}_p2p_broadcasts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", direction="queue_rebroadcasted"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Dropped broadcast rate
spec.description: Inbound P2P broadcasts dropped before acceptance by overlay, TL type, and reason. Existing seen/dedupe guards report repeated payloads as reason=seen.

spec.title: FEC receiver active/cache
spec.description: Inbound FEC decoder streams and delivered broadcast cache entries by overlay.

spec.title: FEC receiver active bytes
spec.description: Estimated memory reserved by inbound FEC decoder streams.

spec.title: FEC receiver drop rate
spec.description: Inbound FEC streams dropped or evicted by receiver protection.

spec.title: FEC receiver delivery rate
spec.description: Inbound FEC broadcasts delivered and late parts skipped by delivered cache.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, pipeline, chain, shard) (rate(${metric_namespace}_sync_block_prepare_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Broadcast pipeline stage p95
spec.description: Inbound broadcast hot-path and exact-download handoff latency split by stage, TL kind, delivery path, and result. exact_wait shows whether the watched hot cache or peer probe won.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, stage, delivery, kind, result) (rate(${metric_namespace}_p2p_broadcast_pipeline_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Lazy cell load rate
spec.description: Successful lazy state cell loads served by state window, decoded cell cache, or Pebble.

spec.title: Candidate block size p95
spec.description: 95th percentile serialized block size, split by whether this node produced the block (collation) or only checked one (validation). The consensus maximum is a hard ceiling on this series.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, chain, origin) (rate(${metric_namespace}_collator_candidate_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", part="block"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Candidate collated data size p95
spec.description: 95th percentile collated-data payload size, split by collation and validation.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, chain, origin) (rate(${metric_namespace}_collator_candidate_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", part="collated"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Transactions per candidate p95
spec.description: 95th percentile transaction count per non-empty candidate. A persistent gap between collation and validation means this node builds blocks of a different size than its peers do.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, chain, origin) (rate(${metric_namespace}_collator_candidate_transactions_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Candidate message mix p95
spec.description: 95th percentile external and imported-internal message counts per candidate, split by collation and validation.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, chain, origin, kind) (rate(${metric_namespace}_collator_candidate_messages_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
